summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the default standard for connecting AI agents to external tools and data sources, with 2026 seeing explosive adoption across developer tooling. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of tools, gateways that handle auth and routing at enterprise scale, and individual MCP servers for specific services like GitHub, browsers, and design tools. MCP matters because it lets AI agents move beyond passive chat into taking real actions—editing repos, querying databases, and automating workflows—through a single interoperable interface.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (Composio, Smithery) are marketplaces that expose many tools through one managed endpoint, gateways (agentgateway, Cloudflare, Kong) are infrastructure that centralizes auth, discovery, and routing across servers, while individual servers (GitHub MCP, Playwright MCP) each connect an agent to one specific service or capability.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search, and repo automation
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage follows GitHub Free/Team/Enterprise tiers
strengths: Works across Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and most clients
tools.best_for: Automating repository workflows, code review, and issue management from AI agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation, web scraping, E2E testing, and page interaction via accessibility tree
strengths: Reliable structured browser control without screenshots
Ideal for agentic web tasks and testing
tools.best_for: Giving agents the ability to navigate, test, and extract data from live websites

tools.name: Filesystem MCP
tools.connects_to: Local file read/write, directory navigation, and file editing on the developer's machine
strengths: Simple and widely bundled by default
tools.best_for: Local file access and manipulation for coding agents in editors like Cursor

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of hosted MCP servers and tools with managed auth, credentials, and sessions
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based and team plans for hosted/managed deployments
tools.best_for: Quickly connecting agents to many tools without managing infrastructure

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 250+ apps including Slack, GitHub, Gmail, Notion, Linear with managed OAuth and auth
tools.pricing_paid: Paid tiers for higher usage, teams, and enterprise auth management
strengths: Strong framework and agent SDK support
tools.best_for: Building production agents that need authenticated access to many SaaS tools

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, and design-to-code context for frontend generation
tools.pricing_paid: Tied to Figma plan tiers; Dev Mode features require paid seats
strengths: Pulls accurate design context into agents
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into code with AI assistance in Cursor and similar tools

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, tables, migrations, and project management
strengths: Lets agents query and manage schemas
tools.best_for: Letting agents interact with and manage Postgres databases and backend data

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP hosting, Workers, auth/OAuth, and deployment of MCP servers at the edge
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans and usage-based pricing for production deployments
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting with OAuth
Strong tooling for building and deploying servers
tools.best_for: Deploying and hosting remote MCP servers securely at scale

tools.name: Notion MCP
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and workspace content for reading and writing docs
strengths: Great for knowledge and docs workflows
Widely adopted for agent memory and notes
tools.best_for: Letting agents read and manage documentation and knowledge bases in Notion

tools.name: Docker MCP
tools.connects_to: Container management, image builds, and a curated catalog of MCP servers via Docker MCP Toolkit
tools.pricing_paid: Docker Pro/Team/Business plans for advanced features
tools.best_for: Running MCP servers safely in containers and managing containerized infrastructure

tools.name: Sentry MCP
tools.connects_to: Error tracking, issues, performance monitoring, and debugging context from Sentry
strengths: Pulls real error context into agents
tools.best_for: Giving agents live error and monitoring data to diagnose and fix bugs

tools.name: Stripe MCP
tools.connects_to: Payments, customers, invoices, subscriptions, and Stripe API operations
tools.pricing_paid: Free to use; standard Stripe transaction fees apply
strengths: Lets agents query and manage billing
tools.best_for: Automating payment and billing operations through AI agents

tools.name: Slack MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Slack channels, messages, search, and workspace interactions
tools.pricing_paid: Free and open source; Slack workspace plan applies
strengths: Most widely adopted community Slack MCP (~1,800 GitHub stars)
Works without full admin app approval
tools.best_for: Letting agents read and post in Slack for team communication workflows
